text:
Avery P: RC promote blocked — `ci/publish` failing on artifact validation step (checksum mismatch) during promote. change window in 55m.
deploy-bot: Promotion paused for run 2026-04-02T11:22Z. Failing checks: artifact-validate. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/77889
Sam K: quick read of logs: index manifest checksum != uploaded blob checksum for `service-frontend:rc-2026.04.02`. Looks like a multipart upload hiccup or a content-encoding bug in the packager.
Avery P: options: 1) re-publish the artifact (attempt fast fix) and re-run promote, 2) pin to previous RC artifact (fastest), 3) abort and investigate fully (miss change window).
Sam K: re-publish attempt is low friction if we can locate the original build artifact. I can trigger a rebuild + republish with same metadata; takes ~10–15m.
Avery P: go for republish first — keep pin as fallback. If republish fails, we pin and push the full investigation to next maintenance window.
Sam K: starting republish workflow now. leaving a note in the run. tagging @InfraBot for registry-side checks.
InfraBot: Noted. Checking registry object store for `service-frontend/rc-2026.04.02`. Found one incomplete multipart upload from upload-id `u-9f8a`. Attempting complete/abort per policy.
Sam K: republish succeeded locally and push to registry initiated. initiating manual promote.
deploy-bot: Manual promote triggered by Sam K. CI run id 77890 queued.
deploy-bot: CI run 77890 artifact-validate: 1/2 checks failed — one replica still returning old checksum on GET. Might be replication lag in the blobstore.
SRE_Oncall: replication lag noted in objectstore metrics. I'll bump retry window for the promote to allow second run, and set alert to page infra if lag >30s persists.
Sam K: re-triggering promote once replication confirms. If second run still fails, we'll pin and cut.
deploy-bot: CI run 77891 queued after replication confirmed. CI run 77891 artifact-validate: 2/2 passed. Promotion allowed. :white_check_mark:
Avery P: cutting RC. release notes draft: "RC 2026.04.02 — republished artifact to address transient multipart upload/replication mismatch during promote; follow-up ticket #6244." Adding replication ids and upload-id in notes.
InfraBot: created follow-up ticket #6244: includes incomplete upload id `u-9f8a`, registry logs, objectstore replication timeline, and suggested retry/backoff improvements for the packager.
Sam K: adding a short guard in packager to verify blob completes and is visible in the registry replicas before reporting success. PR queued with CI tweak.
SRE_Oncall: monitoring in place. I've configured a temporary increased retry for deploy-bot artifact GETs (5 attempts, 10s interval) to absorb small replication windows during promote for next 24h.
Avery P: thanks. if #6244 surfaces a systemic multipart bug we'll schedule a targeted rollback and patch outside the change window. For now RC proceeds.
